title: pvTensorGlyph
body:
## pvTensorGlyph

Places a glyph (sphere by ParaView default; cylinder, box or superquadric) at every point and scales and orients it by the eigen-decomposition of the symmetric part of a point tensor: the major eigenvalue scales the glyph's x axis along the major eigenvector, the medium y, the minor z. Tensors may have 9 components or 6 symmetric components ordered XX, YY, ZZ, XY, YZ, XZ. Output is polydata, by default coloured by input scalars. Use it for stress, strain or diffusion tensors; pvGlyph handles vectors.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Six-component tensors must use XX, YY, ZZ, XY, YZ, XZ; other orders (e.g. Voigt XX, YY, ZZ, YZ, XZ, XY) give wrong orientations.
- Glyph size is ScaleFactor times eigenvalue, so near singularities glyphs explode; enable LimitScalingByEigenvalues with a MaxScaleFactor.
- ParaView warns that glyphing every point of a structured grid can use much memory; subsample first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TensorGlyph`. Identity: `filters/TensorGlyph`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Glyph filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 6,9 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ColorGlyphs` | This property determines whether or not to color the glyphs. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Colorby` | This property determines whether input scalars or computed eigenvalues at the point should be used to color the glyphs. If ThreeGlyphs is set and the eigenvalues are chosen for coloring then each glyph is colored by the corresponding eigenvalue and if not set the color corresponding to the largest eigenvalue is chosen. | `{"type":"enum","values":["input scalars","eigenvalues"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"input scalars"` |
| `ExtractEigenvalues` | Toggle whether to extract eigenvalues from tensor. If false, eigenvalues/eigenvectors are not extracted and the columns of the tensor are taken as the eigenvectors (the norm of column, always positive, is the eigenvalue). If true, the glyph is scaled and oriented according to eigenvalues and eigenvectors; additionally, eigenvalues are provided as new data array. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType` | This property determines which type of glyph will be placed at the points in the input dataset. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Box","Cylinder","Sphere","Superquadric"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Sphere"}` |
| `LimitScalingByEigenvalues` | This property determines whether scaling of glyphs by ScaleFactor times eigenvalue should be limited. This is useful to prevent uncontrolled scaling near singularities. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MaxScaleFactor` | If scaling by eigenvalues should be limited, this value sets an upper limit for scale factor times eigenvalue. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Scalars` | This property indicates the name of the scalar array to use for coloring | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ScaleFactor` | This property specifies the scale factor to scale every glyph by. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Symmetric` | This property determines whether or not to draw a mirror of each glyph. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tensors` | This property indicates the name of the tensor array on which to operate. The indicated array's eigenvalues and eigenvectors are used for scaling and orienting the glyphs. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ThreeGlyphs` | Toggle whether to produce three glyphs, each of which oriented along an eigenvector and scaled according to the corresponding eigenvector. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Box`

Syntax: `{"type":"Box","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/CubeSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the box relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.XLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local x axis (the axis aligned with the vector or major eigenvector). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.YLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local y axis (the medium eigenvector in Tensor Glyph). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.ZLength` | Edge length along the glyph’s local z axis (the minor eigenvector in Tensor Glyph). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Cylinder`

Syntax: `{"type":"Cylinder","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/CylinderSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Capping` | When true, both ends of the cylinder are closed with polygons; when false they are open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the cylinder relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Height` | Length of the cylinder along its local y axis, split equally either side of Center. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Radius` | Radius of the cylinder’s circular cross-section; with Height it sets how thick each glyph is relative to its length. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.Resolution` | Number of facets around the cylinder; higher values look rounder but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"maximum":512,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Sphere`

Syntax: `{"type":"Sphere","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/SphereSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the sphere relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.EndPhi` | Ending latitude measured from the +z pole; 90 gives the upper hemisphere, 180 the full sphere. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.EndTheta` | Ending longitude about the local z axis; less than 360 leaves the sphere open. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.PhiResolution` | Number of divisions in latitude (phi, measured from the +z pole) between StartPhi and EndPhi. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |
| `GlyphType.options.Radius` | Radius of the sphere; the static 0.5 gives a glyph of unit diameter before the operation’s scaling. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.StartPhi` | Starting latitude measured from the +z pole (0) toward the −z pole (180); values above 0 cut off a cap at the top. | `{"maximum":180.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.StartTheta` | Starting longitude, about the local z axis; with EndTheta it lets you draw only a wedge of the sphere. A full sphere uses 0 to 360. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GlyphType.options.ThetaResolution` | Number of divisions around the sphere in longitude (theta, about the local z axis) between StartTheta and EndTheta; higher values look rounder but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"minimum":3,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `3` |

### Nested `GlyphType` → `Superquadric`

Syntax: `{"type":"Superquadric","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `sources/SuperquadricSource`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GlyphType.options.Center` | Centre of the superquadric relative to the glyph’s local origin (the data point). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.PhiResolution` | Number of divisions in latitude; VTK rounds it to a multiple of 4. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":4,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `4` |
| `GlyphType.options.PhiRoundness` | Roundness in the latitudinal (phi) direction: values near 0 give flat, box-like profiles, 1 round ones, and values above 1 pinched profiles. | `{"minimum":0.01,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.01` |
| `GlyphType.options.Scale` | Scale factors [sx, sy, sz] stretching the superquadric along its local axes; normals remain correct under unequal scaling. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `GlyphType.options.Size` | Isotropic size coefficient of the superquadric. Together with Thickness it sets generation coefficients, so it may not equal the exact outer dimension. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `GlyphType.options.ThetaResolution` | Number of divisions in longitude; VTK rounds it to a multiple of 8. Higher values look smoother but add polygons to every glyph. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":8,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `8` |
| `GlyphType.options.ThetaRoundness` | Roundness in the longitudinal (theta) direction: values near 0 give square cross-sections, 1 circular ones, and values above 1 pinched, star-like shapes. | `{"minimum":0.01,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.01` |
| `GlyphType.options.Thickness` | Thickness of the ring when Toroidal is true, from near 0 (thin ring, large hole) to 1 (thick ring, small hole); it does not change the outer radius. Ignored when Toroidal is false. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0001,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0001` |
| `GlyphType.options.Toroidal` | When true, a toroidal (ring-shaped) superquadric with a hole is generated; when false, a solid, ellipsoid-like one. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

  "id": "result",
